inlines.v: EXTOL', verb transitive [Latin extollo; ex and tollo, to raise.] To raise in words or eulogy; to praise; to exalt in commendation; to magnify. We extol virtues, noble exploits, and heroism. Men are too much disposed to extol the rich and despise the poor. EXTOL him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah. Psalms 68:4.
